What follows is United States federal tax law.
burmese_translation: သည့်အရပြတို့ဒေုပ်အခွန်ဥပနှုန်းမျှတို့အချက်

english_source: It changes what a person owes only if that person files a United States federal income tax return.
Most readers in Myanmar do not file one, and for them a gift to Win’s VPN Inc. reduces no tax at all.
burmese_translation: တို့သည့်မြန်ရည်ရဖော်ရွက်ငန်းအလက်သအလက်ကောင်းဥပရှိစွာစွာလှူစာပြသို့ကိုသည့်ချနေသောမွန်

english_source: The English version of this letter does not say so; it was written for readers who file in the United States.
A gift is still a gift; it is simply not a deduction outside the United States tax system.
